essence: The eight-syllabled mantra is the essential core among all mantras.
Twelve syllables should be written on birch bark and six on a copper plate.
The consecration aims at achieving dharma, desire, and wealth.
The universal tantric sequence is meditation, then worship, then recitation.
Placing the script first is necessary for the rite to bear fruit.
